content.question: Does weight decay 1 versus 0 improve held-out generalization after memorization, and does delayed grokking occur by 100000 updates in the prescribed modular-addition MLP?
constraints: Ordered modular addition modulo 97; 2822 training and 6587 held-out pairs per seed
All setup and computation via local broker, offline and sequential
Compute 1800 seconds; setup 300 seconds; 64 attempts; per request at most 180 seconds; session 3600 seconds
stop_rules: Failed correctness or infeasible cost qualification stops confirmation
Resource ceiling produces a partial package
Confirmation horizon is fixed at 100000 and never shortened based on results
All attempts persist and retries get new identities
At most two audit revision cycles

unresolved.finding: Four independent paired seeds provide weak population uncertainty; t intervals assume a suitable sampling distribution and sign-flip p-values are coarse.
unresolved.resolution: Report each paired difference, SD, SE, 95% df=3 t interval and all-16 sign-flip calculation; make no broad population/significance claim. More independent seeds would be needed.

unresolved.finding: A 100000-update horizon cannot establish whether censored runs ever generalize; only two decay levels and one MLP/optimizer/split fraction were tested.
unresolved.resolution: Use explicit censoring/null event times, separate memorization/improvement/grokking claims, and restrict every conclusion to this configuration.

unresolved.finding: The installed checklist supplies schema/direct-digest assurance, and this substantive critique is by the same agent.
unresolved.resolution: Label scientific critique provisional; do not claim independent scientific peer review. Independent review remains a future requirement for stronger assurance.

unresolved.finding: 100-update evaluations and a first-of-three rule discretize event times; a three-point window is not proof of permanent generalization.
unresolved.resolution: Report both initial and confirming evaluation times plus one-factor definition sensitivity. No change to the frozen primary analysis.

unresolved.finding: Held-out ordered pairs share the same modular operation and may include swapped versions of training pairs; examples are not independent tasks.
unresolved.resolution: Use seed as the independent unit and avoid extrapolating to new operations or architectures. The supplied split is followed exactly.
